sb.name: Great Fir Drake
sb.senses: Blindsight 60 ft, Darkvision 120 ft, passive Perception 19

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: As a Bonus Action, the drake can produce dim light in a 15 ft radius, or bright light in a 15 ft radius and dim light for an additional 15 ft radius. The drake can end this effect as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Prickly Pines
traits.desc: If a creature successfully hits the drake with a melee attack, the creature takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.desc: If the drake fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drake makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Incandescent Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Color Spray|Colour Spray]].

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Incandescent Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 90 ft long, 5 ft wide Line. Failure: 55 (10d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The drake casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Color Spray|Color Spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|Faerie Fire]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|Hypnotic Pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Plant Growth|Plant Growth]]

legendary_actions.name: Bright Tail Lash
legendary_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, a creature the drake can see within 15 ft. Failure: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage, and the target is knocked Prone.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.desc: The drake moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary_actions.name: Twinkling Lights
legendary_actions.desc: The drake uses Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|Faerie Fire]].

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3 (4 in its lair). One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: The pudding gremlin explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the pudding gremlin. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the pudding gremlin doesn't move on its turn, it has Advantage when taking the Hide action.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft, Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15 ft Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Create Gremlin (1/Day)
actions.desc: If the pudding gremlin is within 10 ft of an ordinary pudding, it can turn the ordinary pudding into another pudding gremlin. This new pudding gremlin appears in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of the original pudding gremlin and acts as its ally.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.desc: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft, Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Ice Knife|Ice Knife]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fear|Fear]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|Suggestion]]

bonus_actions.name: Freezing Glare (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition, and is turned into an ice statue.
